scene_index_first_policy.fallback: If scene mapping is absent, try the component runtime index, then bounded live search for unresolved semantics. Invalid IDs, ambiguity or unavailable variants require targeted search; do not scan all pages by default.

scene_index_first_policy.refresh: Record discovered stale mappings and update them only within explicit Skill/index maintenance authorization; ordinary read-only lookup must not publish Skill changes.
scene_index_first_policy.tool_requirements: If the active MCP requires a library/search preflight, perform the minimum scoped lookup after local index resolution; do not treat it as authorization for an all-library scan.
scene_index_first_policy.variant_gallery_lookup_rule: use instance_id and variant_master_id for lookup and write preparation; card_id is visual presentation only and must not trigger a card traversal
scene_index_first_policy.visual_queries: Use --intent visualize; exact valid screenshot cache or targeted live screen rendering. Rendering a screen does not require scanning its entire component library. Dark-mode verification rules remain unchanged.
scene_index_first_policy.write_tasks: Resolve exact master or variant from matched components.yaml entry; read current live properties, variants, resizing, slots and relevant variable bindings before creating or modifying instances. Index and review examples never substitute for masters.
